releases.name: Last Flag
releases.summary: Hide your flag. Find the enemy flag. Run it back, then defend for a minute to win it. Welcome to Last Flag: a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag.

releases.name: Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart
releases.summary:
Itsara Amata x Corecell presents Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart, an indie action tactical RPG set in the fierce world of rival Japanese delinquent schools.

The game blends tactical decision-making with dynamic action-timing combat. Plan your moves, position your allies, and master the timing of punches, kicks, guards, counters, and special attacks to win each battle.

Players will fight alongside memorable allies, challenge rival schools, and rise through the ranks in a story of friendship, pride, and the drive to become the strongest.

One school. One rule. Prove you're the strongest.

releases.name: Danger Mouse
releases.summary:
Baron Greenback has fallen on hard times...

Feeling nostalgic for the “bad old days,” Greenback launches his boldest evil plan yet, forcing Danger Mouse and Penfold to re-live all their epic encounters. 

Will Greenback get a second chance at victory, or is this the final game over?

releases.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
releases.summary:
Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

He-Man, Teela, and Man-At-Arms do battle over 12 sprawling and diverse levels of non-stop action, armed with a host of moves, abilities, and power-ups as they work to stop Skeletor’s ancient ritual that threatens to plunge Eternia into darkness!

releases.name: Super Battle Golf
releases.summary:
An online 1-8 player golf game where everyone plays at the same time. 

Swing, shoot, sabotage, and finish first by any means necessary in a free-for-all rush to the hole.

releases.name: Endurance Motorsport Series
releases.summary:
Endurance is one of the most demanding and comprehensive requirements in motor sport. In this sport, more than in others, the key to success lies in perfect team coordination. Endurance Motorsport Series lets you experience this not only in the role of driver, but also in the heart of the pits as a racing engineer.

Endurance Motorsport Series provides unique gameplay in which the way you adapt your decisions and race strategy to events (incidents, weather, etc) is just as important as your driving skills. You will have to find the best balance between speed and consistency in your search for victory.

Developed using the KT Engine, which has been specifically developed for motorsport simulation, Endurance Motorsport Series offers realistic driving and faithfully reproduces some of the world's most legendary tracks.

releases.name: Final Kick Football Legends
releases.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

releases.name: DAVE THE DIVER: Complete Edition
releases.summary:
Complete Edition contains:
- Dave the Diver
- In the Jungle DLC
- Dredge DLC
- Godzilla DLC
- Ichiban's Holiday DLC
- Digital Soundtrack
- Digital Artbook

DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, single player adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration and fishing during the day and sushi restaurant management at night. Join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole.

releases.name: OMG! - Overhead Micro Game
releases.summary:
OMG! – Overhead Micro Game is a fast, single-screen puzzle-action experience where every level is a tiny, perfect little death trap. 

Navigate over fifty hand-crafted, bite-sized arenas packed with lasers, switches, pits, and a clone army of creatures who are absolutely not on your side. Reach the shimmering Exit Orb to escape before you’re vaporized, chomped, or find yourself falling screaming into the void.

Standing in your way is The Expositor, an antagonist who believes your repeated deaths are a teaching opportunity. For him. Not you.

releases.name: King's Blade
releases.summary:
Step into a grim world of heroic fantasy with King's Blade - a classic Beat 'em up inspired by the universe of Conan the Barbarian and legendary arcade titles like Golden Axe and Streets of Rage.

Take command of the elite warriors of the King's Blade and fight your way through the hordes of the Barganian Empire! Crush enemies in epic brawls, traverse deadly lands, and carve a path to the heart of the enemy capital.

Join forces with friends in local co-op for up to 4 players, or add AI fighters to your team!

releases.name: Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire
releases.summary:
Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire is an action-farming-roguelite set in Transylvania, the homeland of Dracula and his rebellious lastborn son, Voltaire. An epiphany results in a change of heart for the young vampire: abandoning blood in favor of a plant-based diet out of spite to prove to his father that neck-biting is not the only way for vampires to thrive.

The Elder Vampire doesn't take kindly to such ideas, but with the help of uncle(s) Frank and Stein, Voltaire slips away from his father's gaze. Once on his own, he embarks on a creepy, cute odyssey full of veggie recipes, a plant-based lifestyle, and hand-drawn art celebrating the gloriously macabre!

releases.name: Night Z: Definitely Not Worth It
releases.summary: It was supposed to be easy.Go in, grab a package from an abandoned medical center, come back rich enough to never worry about food, water, or getting eaten again. That's it. A simple courier job. The kind I've done a hundred times before.Only this time... something's off.The city's worse than usual. Streets are packed with the kind of zombies that don't just stand around waiting their turn. Some run. Some throw things. One of them looked like it used to work construction and still takes the job very seriously.And the medical center?Yeah, that place should've stayed buried.Inside, it's not just infected - it's wrong. Broken equipment, leaking chemicals, things that used to be human but clearly got a little too involved with whatever was stored there. I don't know what this "Drug Z" really is, but judging by the size of the thing guarding it... I'm guessing it doesn't come with clear instructions.Still, a job's a job.You'll push through ruined streets, tight alleys, and places that smell like bad decisions, scavenging whatever you can carry - ammo, scraps, something that might have been food at some point. Weapons aren't exactly premium out here, but if it swings, shoots, or explodes, it'll do.Most of the time.The plan was simple: get in, get out, get paid.The reality is a lot more running, a lot less dignity, and way too many close calls.And just when you think you made it...that's usually when everything goes completely wrong.Look, I'm not saying this job isn't worth it.I'm just saying... if I survive this, I'm switching careers.Maybe pizza delivery.Feels safer.

releases.name: Through Blood and Dragons - Dragon Wars
releases.summary:
Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars is a third-person, fantasy-themed, on-rails shooter for a single player; players take the role of an archer on the back of a dragon AND the dragon itself through short first-person dragon-breath segments. It utilizes standard point and shoot gameplay synonymous with the genre, with the addition of a snapping 360°view system. 

The game has several cosmetic options available for unlocking OR for purchase. Furthermore, players are rewarded in-game for interaction with other “The Forged and The Fallen” media.

releases.name: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
releases.summary:
Suburban rivalries erupt into full scale mayhem in a 4v4 battle of home improvement against home destruction. 

Assemble a team from a cast of unique iconic residents, set up defenses to protect your home and use every imaginable tool to knock out your neighbors and wreck their home before they do the same to you.

releases.name: Way of the Hunter 2
releases.summary: Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the Canadian wilderness.

releases.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
releases.summary:
A hero’s work is never done! Disorder is brewing, and the world stands before a threat unlike any other. A new danger is growing in power, ready to descend upon the land and unleash mayhem.

Return to the world of Minecraft Dungeons in an all‑new action RPG adventure, brimming with high‑stakes encounters, thrilling challenges, and never‑before‑seen locations, as you set out to save a world in crisis. Will you and your allies prevail against the forces of evil and save the day once more?

releases.name: Blades & Battles
releases.summary:
Blades & Battles is a fantasy Beat'Em Up game that takes players to the heart of the legendary world of King Arthur in his barbarian youth. A modern version of classic titles such as Golden Axe.

The game features 2 playable characters: Arthur and Lancelot, with their own skill sets and sword fighting styles.

Filled with beautiful scenery and cinematic interactive moments, it's an immersive, action-packed experience of chivalry, honor and adventure.

releases.name: Gothic II Complete Classic
releases.summary:
Continue the story of the Nameless Hero in Gothic II Complete Classic, the award-winning sequel that improved on its predecessor in every way. Experience it now for the first time on Nintendo Switch.

Gothic II Complete Classic brings together the excitement of Gothic II and the add-on Night of the Raven to your fingertips for the first time on a console.

You have torn down the magical barrier and released the prisoners of the Mine Valley. Now the former criminals of the forests and mountains are causing trouble around the capital of Khorinis. The town militia is powerless due to their low amount of force - outside of the town, everyone is helpless against the attacks of the bandits.

releases.name: TOEM 2
releases.summary:
Ready your camera and set off on a new photo adventure in TOEM 2!

Tie those sneakers and ready your camera, it’s time to set off on a new photo adventure in TOEM 2! Head off on a relaxing journey, spurred on by your newly-awakened passion for discovering and photographing mysterious “events” known as TOEMs. TOEM 2 was crafted to be welcoming for both returning fans of TOEM and those who want to jump in for the first time.

Explore: Run, jump, and climb your way through all-new cozy environments, uncovering hidden paths, scenic viewpoints, and small details waiting to be discovered. The world is built to reward curiosity, so take your time and wander wherever your camera leads you.

Meet: Encounter a cast of new quirky characters and adorable critters along your journey. Lend a hand to new faces, create lasting friendships, and catalogue your memories as you go along.

Snap: Your camera has gotten an upgrade! Not only can you snap pictures to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and document your discoveries, you can also use them in more unconventional ways, with new attachments letting you overcome various problems in each region.

Stamp: Fill your journal with stamps as you complete quests, document discoveries, and expand your critter compendium. Each stamp is not only a reminder of the little wonders you’ve uncovered along the way — they’re also your ticket to unlocking the next region.

Set Your Pace: TOEM 2 is built to be experienced at your own pace with no time limits or tricky requirements for full completion. Listen to music on a bench, smell the flowers, admire the sights and enjoy.

releases.name: Transport Fever 3
releases.summary: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

releases.name: Hard Bullet
releases.summary:
Hard Bullet is a brutal physics sandbox VR game with realistic enemy interactions, gore and dismemberment, slow motion abilities, survival modes, lots of guns and cinematic environment destruction.

Control time like in famous PC and console blockbusters - perform long jumps in slow motion and kick enemies with your overpowered fists.

Expect variety of famous pistols, submachine guns and shotguns, you'll get some sweet rifles and machine guns as well.

Accurate full body IK systems. You can turn on real gore mayhem with body dismembering, bullet holes and blood fountains if you are ready.

releases.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered
releases.summary:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered modernizes the generation-defining RPG with a range of upgrades and enhancements to visuals, performance, gameplay, and more. Become monster slayer for hire Geralt of Rivia and journey across the war-torn Northern Kingdoms to find your adopted daughter, Ciri, before the spectral forces of the Wild Hunt take her incredible power for their own. Included in Remastered are two critically acclaimed expansions — Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine — to expand the legendary story even further.

Explore a Dark Fantasy World — Journey through the war-torn Northern Kingdoms and explore richly detailed regions, from bustling cities to forgotten ancient ruins and superstitious villages.

Experience an Unforgettable Story — Traverse the Continent in search of Geralt’s adopted daughter Ciri, the Child of Prophecy, who is being ruthlessly hunted by the spectral Wild Hunt.

Master a Witcher’s Arsenal — Embody the White Wolf and show your foes what it means to be a witcher with a variety of swords, potions, bombs, combat magic, and more.

Modernized and Upgraded — Refined with an upgraded skill system, revamped combat, improved visuals, and more, Remastered is the definitive way to enjoy this acclaimed RPG.

releases.name: Keep Driving
releases.summary:
Keep Driving is a management RPG about slowly making your way through a procedurally generated pixel art open world. Pick up hitchhikers with their own personalities and stories; upgrade, customize and repair your car. Solve challenges on the road using a unique turn-based ‘combat’ system, using your own skills and whatever’s lying around in the glovebox to make it through.

At the end of your road trip, return back to the beginning and see what happens if you had followed a different path. There are multiple endings, with each taking about 1-4 hours to complete. 

Immerse yourself in the land through its highways, dirt tracks, and calm country roads. And remember to enjoy the ride. You're young and don't have much to lose.
